title: Fairy Legends and Traditions of the South of Ireland
sourceTitle: Fairy Legends and Traditions of the South of Ireland
author: Thomas Crofton Croker
description: "Fairy Legends and Traditions of the South of Ireland" by Thomas Crofton Croker is a collection of folklore tales written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The work dives into the rich tapestry of Irish myths, sharing various legends about fairies and the supernatural beings that inhabit the landscapes of South Ireland.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Crofton Croker (1798–1854) wrote Fairy Legends and Traditions of the South of Ireland. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
works: Fairy Legends and Traditions of the South of Ireland
